## Walkthrough

This pull request adds comprehensive JSON export and import functionality to the extension settings page. It introduces constants and normalization helpers to standardize settings format, updates form I/O with validation, adds HTML UI controls and CSS styling, implements a status feedback system with timed clearing, and develops full export/import logic with file handling and chrome storage integration. The lifecycle integration wires the new features into existing load/save workflows, while defensive improvements harden weekly report domain summarization and filtering. Documentation explains the export format and import flexibility.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces the ability to export and import extension settings as JSON files, including updates to the documentation, UI styles, and settings management logic. A critical issue was identified where the function `normalizeTimeframeMinutes` is used but not defined, which will result in a `ReferenceError` when loading or saving settings.

**Actionable comments posted: 1**

rest with a brief reason, keep changes minimal, and validate.

Inline comments:
In `@settings/settings.html`:
- Line 63: The file input with id "import-settings-file" is missing an
accessible label; update the <input id="import-settings-file"> either by adding
an aria-label attribute (e.g., aria-label="Import settings file") or by creating
a corresponding <label for="import-settings-file">Import settings</label> (you
can visually hide the label with an accessible CSS class if you want it hidden
visually). Ensure the label text clearly describes the input's purpose and that
the id "import-settings-file" is used in the for attribute if adding a <label>.
```

```
